mission: Capacity75 session 12: guarded Yuyu identity-capture enqueue tool for approved NEW100 batches (tool and tests only; no intent written by this PR)

impacts.reason: Operator tool, run explicitly; merging it writes nothing. Dry run by default; --apply writes pending Yuyu identity-evidence capture intents through the canonical freshness_queue.plan_discovery_scope writer, in the shape the collector's load_intent accepts. Approved list pinned by SHA-256; every entry re-resolved live (ambiguous family, unchanged digest, authoritative release_product_id, complete 2..12 siblings, listing identity, no active mapping, no reviewed decision, no other capture scope, no shared print); one failure refuses the batch with no write; reruns are no-ops. Never writes proposals, reviews or mappings; no source request; not imported by any collector (scripts/ is outside every collector image and watch path).

Postgres: dry run writes nothing; apply writes the exact intent and the real collector load_intent accepts it after a claim; rerun is a no-op; changed digest/release/siblings/candidate refuse the whole batch; active sibling mapping, other capture scope and shared prints refuse; list pinned and strict; no proposal or mapping writes; tool outside every collector runtime path. Test file only: not a collector runtime input.
